Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                           ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current Cl-2, Neighborhood Commercial District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 4-F in the area bounded by:

              A line 75.0 feet north of and parallel to West Cullerton Street; the public alley next
              east of and parallel to South Jefferson Street; a line 25.0 feet north of and parallel
              to West Cullerton Street; and South Jefferson Street

to those of an B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address: 1931-33 South Jefferson Street
                                      CITY OF CHICAGO

                          THE CHICAGO ZONING ORDINANCE

9. Present Zoning District       Cl-2                     Proposed Zoning District           B2-3

10. Lot Size in square feet (or dimensions)           5.000 square feet

11. Current Use of the property            vacant lot and one two story residential building

12. Reason for rezoning the property: to rezone the property to sub-divide the zoning lots into
    two lots and construct three story residential building with three dwelling units and a
    detached three car garage on each lot.

 13.    Describe the proposed use ofthe property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
dwelling units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space;
and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)                   The subiect propertv is comprised of a
double lot that is 5.000 square feet known as 1931 and 1933 South Jefferson Street. The lot known as 1931
South Jefferson Street is a vacant lot. The lot known as 1933 South Jefferson is improved with a vacant
two storv residential building with two dwelling units and no parking. The Applicant proposes to rezone
the propertv to split the zoning lots and construct a three story residential building with three dwelling units
and a detached three car garage at 1931 South Jefferson Street and to demolish the existing structure at
 1933 South Jefferson Street and also construct a new three storv residential building with three dwelling
units and a detached three car garage . The proposed height of each building is 47'-2". This application
is being filed to correct a clerical error on a previous application #21041 passed by City Council on 06-22-
22022.

14. The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
    and/or a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
